content: in 1982, a section of the San Joaquin River was cut off from the land it once fed . in 2026 crews started to undo that history . the Grasslands Floodplain Restoration Project has reconnected the river to over 220 acres of historic floodplain habitat .

title: 'Freeze seats for 25 years': Congress backs Vijay-led TN govt's delimitation stand
content: former union minister and senior Congress leader said the party wants the existing allocation of Lok Sabha seats to be maintained for another 25 years . there should be no change to the current strength of 543 seats or Tamil Nadu’s 39 constituencies .

title: 'U-turn in a week': DMK slams Vijay over delimitation stance after Shah meeting
content: the DMK accuses the chief minister of taking a 'U-turn' on the issue of delimitation . he met amit Shah in Tamil Nadu on the same week that a resolution was passed to not increase the current number of 543 MPs . the party says he has changed his position .

title: 'Waiting for astrologer to fix date?' Udhayanidhi asks Vijay to act on corruption claims
content: udhayanidhi questioned the delay in making the findings public . he said the government did not have sufficient evidence to support its allegations . the chief minister urged him to open the files immediately and take action if there was evidence of wrongdoing .

title: Partnership in crime, incubated behind bars in Telangana
content: Prisons are meant to reform offenders, but for some habitual criminals, they can also provide an environment to make contacts, exchange know-how and forge bonds that continue after release. Investigators in Telangana are finding such links in cases ranging from vehicle thefts to attention-diversion fraud. Naveen Kumar examines how prison associations can evolve into criminal partnerships, and whether these links point to an unintended breeding ground for crime in jail

title: Local body polls announced in Rajasthan; Congress launches panchayat task force campaign
content: The model code of conduct came into force in all 309 urban local bodies with the declaration of elections.

title: Government allows duty-free import of 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar until October 31
content: To control prices, the government imposed a stockholding limit on bulk consumers using more than 10 tonnes of sugar a month

title: Over 11.18 lakh permanent houses to be built in Bihar under PMAY-G, says Shivraj Singh Chouhan
content: The ‘Grih Pravesh’ ceremony for 2.35 lakh Pradhan Mantri Awas units was completed in the 2026-27 financial year; house keys to beneficiaries and sanction letters to newly selected beneficiaries distributed

title: Black dust chokes lives in Visakhapatnam
content: For residents of the One Town area, pollution is no longer an occasional problem but an everyday reality, with black dust settling on homes, vehicles and streets and concerns mounting over its impact on health. From the port-adjoining lanes of the Old City to parts of Gajuwaka, residents say that coal and iron ore dust, industrial emissions, and vehicular pollution have made the air a persistent source of fear, writes Harish Gilai.

title: Manifesting Modi’s mantra in Muzaffarnagar
content: Cultivating harmony in the sugarcane bowl, philanthropist Ameer Ahamed empowers Muslim youth by anchoring modern education in theological values

title: In Pulwama, cricket heals wounds of the past
content: Nightlife has been a dream for the turmoil-hit district. However, cricket in the past two years has acted as a healing process for locals.

title: Congress MLAs boycott first day’s proceedings at Rajasthan Assembly monsoon session
content: The Congress MLAs staged a dharna outside the Assembly, protesting school entry restrictions and demanding Education Minister Madan Dilawar’s resignation

title: Tharoor calls new Parliament building 'soulless conference centre', lacking in intimacy
content: There is a sort of distancing, which almost seems to be a metaphor for the polarisation of our politics, says Congress MP Shashi Tharoor

title: BJP MLA Jai Devi Kaushal alleges caste discrimination at Uttar Pradesh temple event
content: The MLA urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to take notice of the incident.

title: Sajjan Kumar, former Congress MP convicted in anti-Sikh riots case, is dead
content: Convicted twice but acquitted in another case, the former Congress MP spent his final years in prison after decades of investigations, committee reports and court battles

title: Lawyers stage protest outside BCI office, seek chairman’s resignation amid NALSAR row
content: Questioning Manan Kumar Mishra’s 14-year tenure as chairman, the protesters wanted reforms in the BCI’s election mechanism

title: 'No FIR, so we sit': Rahul on dharna outside DCP office along with pellet gun victim
content: former congress chief met senior police officials at the DCP office in Connaught Place . he sought registration of a complaint over police action and excessive use of force against student protesters during a demonstration over NEET irregularities on July 20 .
